pages.text: Digs a pit trap in the sand.

Digs a funnel in sand and sits buried at the bottom. $(thing)Tell:$() the pit and the trickling sand. It drags everything nearby toward it, then bites and roots you in place. Off sand it's just a slow bug.$(br2)Drops $(item)Antlion Mandible$().
pages.title: Antlion
